label: Pip (3D: a penguin chick waddles, belly-slides and brings the letter)

preset.title: Pip Slides In
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it, and wave to Pip.
body: I waddled all the way across the ice, slid the last bit on my tummy, and here I am, with this letter for you.
Happy birthday. Stay warm, stay silly, and save me a slice of cake.

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that springs up while Pip cheers. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.
